chapterInfo.content:
59
Dwom a ɛtia nkɔnkɔnsa
Wɔde ma dwonkyerɛfoɔ sɛ wɔnto no “Al-taset” sankuo nne so. Dawid abebuo dwom. Ɔtoo no berɛ a Saulo soma baa ne fie sɛ wɔnku no no.
1 # 1 Sa 19.11 Me Nyankopɔn, gye me firi m’atamfoɔ nsam,
bɔ me ho ban, wɔn a wɔsɔre tia me no ho.
2Gye me amumuyɛfoɔ mu,
na gye me nkwa firi mogyapɛfoɔ nsam.
3Na hwɛ, wɔtɛ me kra,
akokobirefoɔ boaboa wɔn ho ano tia me.
AWURADE, ɛnyɛ me mmarato anaa me bɔne nti.
4 # Dwom 44.23 Ɛnyɛ amumuyɛ nti na wɔtu mmirika siesie wɔn ho.
Sɔre bɛboa me, na fa w’ani hwɛ.
5Na wo, AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn,
nyane bɛhwɛ amanaman nyinaa,
nhunu amumuyɛfoɔ nkontompofoɔ mmɔbɔ.
6 # Dwom 59.14 Wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,
wɔpɔ so sɛ akraman,
na wɔdi kuro mu kyinhyia.
7Hwɛ, wɔde wɔn ano woro kasa,
nkrantɛ wɔ wɔn ano, na “hwan na ɔteɛ?”
8 # Dwom 2.4 Na wo, AWURADE, wosere wɔn,
wodi amanaman nyinaa ho fɛw.
9M’ahoɔden, wo na mehwɛ wo kwan,
na Onyankopɔn yɛ m’abankɛseɛ.
10 # Dwom 54.7 Me Nyankopɔn de n’adom bɛhyia me,
Onyankopɔn bɛma mahunu deɛ mepɛ, m’atɛfoɔ ho.
11Nku wɔn, na me man werɛ amfi;
fa w’ahoɔden bɔ wɔn pansam, na fa wɔn hwe fam,
yɛn kyɛm ne wo, AWURADE.
12Wɔn anomu nsɛm yɛ nsɛmmɔne nko,
enti ma wɔnkye wɔn, wɔn ahantan mu,
ne nseɛ ne atorɔ a wɔdie no nti.
13Hye wɔn abufuo mu,
hye wɔn na wɔantena hɔ,
na ma wɔnhunu sɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔdi Yakob so hene
kɔsi asase ano.
14 # Dwom 59.6 Na wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,
wɔpɔ so sɛ akraman
na wɔdi kuro mu kyinhyia.
15Wɔn deɛ, wɔdwane hwehwɛ aduane,
na sɛ wɔmmee a, wɔtena hɔ anadwo.
16Na me deɛ, mɛto w’ahoɔden ho dwom,
na mato w’adɔeɛ ho ahurisie dwom anɔpa,
sɛ woayɛ me abankɛseɛ
ne me hia da mu dwanekɔbea.
17M’ahoɔden, wo na mɛto wo dwom,
na Onyankopɔn ne m’abankɛseɛ,
m’adom Nyankopɔn.

Me Nyankopɔn, gye me firi m’atamfoɔ nsam,
bɔ me ho ban, wɔn a wɔsɔre tia me no ho.
Gye me amumuyɛfoɔ mu,
na gye me nkwa firi mogyapɛfoɔ nsam.
Na hwɛ, wɔtɛ me kra,
akokobirefoɔ boaboa wɔn ho ano tia me.
AWURADE, ɛnyɛ me mmarato anaa me bɔne nti.
Ɛnyɛ amumuyɛ nti na wɔtu mmirika siesie wɔn ho.
Sɔre bɛboa me, na fa w’ani hwɛ.
Na wo, AWURADE, asafo Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn,
nyane bɛhwɛ amanaman nyinaa,

Wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,

na wɔdi kuro mu kyinhyia.
Hwɛ, wɔde wɔn ano woro kasa,

Na wo, AWURADE, wosere wɔn,
wodi amanaman nyinaa ho fɛw.
M’ahoɔden, wo na mehwɛ wo kwan,

Me Nyankopɔn de n’adom bɛhyia me,
Onyankopɔn bɛma mahunu deɛ mepɛ, m’atɛfoɔ ho.
Nku wɔn, na me man werɛ amfi;
fa w’ahoɔden bɔ wɔn pansam, na fa wɔn hwe fam,
yɛn kyɛm ne wo, AWURADE.
Wɔn anomu nsɛm yɛ nsɛmmɔne nko,
enti ma wɔnkye wɔn, wɔn ahantan mu,
ne nseɛ ne atorɔ a wɔdie no nti.
Hye wɔn abufuo mu,
hye wɔn na wɔantena hɔ,
na ma wɔnhunu sɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔdi Yakob so hene
kɔsi asase ano.
Na wɔsane ba anwummerɛ,
wɔpɔ so sɛ akraman
na wɔdi kuro mu kyinhyia.
Wɔn deɛ, wɔdwane hwehwɛ aduane,
na sɛ wɔmmee a, wɔtena hɔ anadwo.
Na me deɛ, mɛto w’ahoɔden ho dwom,
na mato w’adɔeɛ ho ahurisie dwom anɔpa,
sɛ woayɛ me abankɛseɛ
ne me hia da mu dwanekɔbea.
M’ahoɔden, wo na mɛto wo dwom,
na Onyankopɔn ne m’abankɛseɛ,
m’adom Nyankopɔn.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
